title: Sweet Tooth
theme: Desserts in the parks and candy on screen
intro: [excited] Grab a spoon and loosen that belt, because tonight's board is Sweet Tooth! [laughs] Every clue is a dessert, a treat, or a piece of movie candy. Dentists, please look away.

art.prompt: A towering candy-colored dessert landscape with soft-serve swirl mountains, a river of chocolate, churro bridges, gumdrop trees and a pineapple sun setting over a sprinkle-covered park street Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Beignet There, Done That
categories.intro: Our film category is The Princess and the Frog, a movie so tasty you should watch it with a napkin. [chuckles] Powdered sugar everywhere.

art.prompt: A steamy New Orleans café counter at dawn piled high with powdered-sugar beignets, a brass trumpet resting nearby, wrought-iron balconies and a riverboat visible through the window Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Tiana's famous fried pastries, covered in powdered sugar.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is beignets! [cheerful] Say it with me: ben-YAYS. Now say it with powdered sugar on your shirt.

clues.clue: The Princess and the Frog is set in this Louisiana city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is New Orleans! [excited] The Big Easy. Easy on jazz, very hard on diets.

clues.clue: Big Daddy La Bouff gets crowned king of the parade during this festival.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mardi Gras! [laughs] King for a day, and Charlotte is princess until midnight. Royal deadlines are brutal.

clues.clue: Louis the alligator dreams of playing this jazz instrument.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the trumpet! [chuckles] A gator who just wants to play jazz with the big boys. Dream big, Louis.

clues.clue: Charlotte's rich and jolly dad, Big Daddy La Bouff, has this first name.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Eli! Eli Big Daddy La Bouff. He loves Tiana's beignets more than anyone in town.

categories.title: Candy Coated Cinema
categories.intro: Sweets on the silver screen! [mischievously] I hope nobody snuck any candy into this studio. I'm watching you.

art.prompt: A retro movie-theater concession stand overflowing with lollipops, candy canes, chocolate bars and giant popsicles, a glowing projector beam cutting through the dark Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins sings that a spoonful of sugar helps this go down.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the medicine! [cheerful] In the most delightful way. Mary Poppins: practically perfect AND a pharmacist.

clues.clue: In Up, Russell lures the giant bird Kevin with this sweet snack.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is chocolate! [laughs] Kevin will follow ANYONE with chocolate. Same, Kevin. Same.

clues.clue: This lisping ruler of Sugar Rush turns out to be the racing villain Turbo.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is King Candy! [gasps] Sweet on the outside, glitchy on the inside. Watch your back, Vanellope.

clues.clue: In Wreck-It Ralph, Ralph and Vanellope build her race car at this candy-themed mini game.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Kart Bakery! [chuckles] Wreck-It Ralph baking a car... the frosting job was DEFINITELY creative.

clues.clue: In Zootopia, Nick Wilde melts a giant Jumbo-pop to make and sell these.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is pawpsicles! [sarcastic] Totally legal hustle. Sold back to lemmings for a nice profit.

categories.title: Sweet Rhyme Time
categories.intro: Each answer is a Disney name plus a dessert that rhymes with it. [laughs] Yes, they get silly. That's the point.

art.prompt: Playful floating desserts arranged in matching pairs: a flan, a funnel cake, a fondue pot, a gelato cup and a stack of candy bars, bouncing on a pastel rhyme-like rainbow Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: The Lion King's villain plus chocolate candy treats.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Scar Bars! [mischievously] Long live the king... of chocolate.

clues.clue: Mickey's pet dog plus Italian ice cream.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pluto Gelato! [cheerful] It comes with a bone. No. Wait. Please don't add a bone.

clues.clue: A heroine who saved China plus a wobbly caramel custard.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mulan Flan! [laughs] Brings honor to us all. And dessert.

clues.clue: A princess with long golden hair plus a fried fair dessert, minus the word cake.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rapunzel Funnel! [chuckles] Seventy feet of powdered sugar, braided.

clues.clue: The Jungle Book's bear plus a pot of melted chocolate for dipping.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Baloo Fondue! Look for the bare necessities... like a skewer and a strawberry.

categories.title: Snap a Snack
categories.intro: Real park treats, real photos. [whispers] Do not lick the screen. I'm serious, we just cleaned it.

art.prompt: A sunny theme-park snack cart on a festive street with striped awning, a frosty display case of ice cream bars, cinnamon churros in a rack and pineapple soft-serve in cups Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: These Disneyland favorites are fried and rolled in this sweet coating.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is cinnamon sugar! [cheerful] The churro: the official snack of standing in line.

clues.clue: Under the chocolate coating, the classic Mickey ice cream bar is this flavor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is vanilla! [laughs] Pro tip: eat the ears first. Speed matters in Florida heat.

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom, you can get a pineapple Dole Whip float like this one at this Adventureland stand.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aloha Isle! [excited] Right next to the Enchanted Tiki Room. The birds sing, you slurp.

clues.clue: This eight-scoop sundae served in a mini sink is the star dessert at Beaches and Cream Soda Shop.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Kitchen Sink! [gasps] Eight scoops, every topping, and a whole can of whipped cream. Bring friends. Lots of friends.

media.prompt: A giant ice cream sundae served in a shiny miniature metal kitchen sink, overflowing with scoops, whipped cream, cherries, brownie chunks and colorful sprinkles, on a retro soda shop counter, no people or characters

clues.clue: Served at Gaston's Tavern, this frozen apple drink with toasted marshmallow and passion fruit-mango foam is named for Gaston's sidekick.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is LeFou's Brew! [chuckles] Nobody sips like LeFou, nobody slurps like LeFou...

media.prompt: A rustic wooden tavern table with a hefty foaming stein of pale frozen apple drink topped with orange foam, antlers on the stone wall behind, a crackling fireplace, no people or characters

categories.title: Sweets and Treats Trivia
categories.intro: Our wildcard is for the snack planners who choose their park day by the dessert menu. [laughs] You know who you are.

art.prompt: A whimsical bakery window with giant chocolate chip cookies, frosted pastries, caramel bubbling in a copper kettle, and toaster pastries cooling on a gingham cloth Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Disney breakfast waffles are famously shaped like this character's head.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey Mouse! [cheerful] Three circles, maximum syrup storage. Engineering!

clues.clue: Named for a Mary Poppins song, this bakery cafe sits on Disneyland's Main Street, U.S.A.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe! [chuckles] Penguin waiters not included.

clues.clue: At Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land, these homemade toaster-style pastries are a fan favorite.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lunch Box Tarts! [excited] Like the toaster pastry from your childhood, but way better.

clues.clue: This Disney Springs bakery is known for giant half-pound cookies and very long lines.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gideon's Bakehouse! [sighs] The line moves slowly, but those cookies weigh as much as a small cat.

clues.clue: Presented by Werther's Original, this sweet shop in EPCOT's Germany pavilion is all about caramel.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Karamell-Küche! That means caramel kitchen. [laughs] Germany: home of engineering and sticky fingers.
